description:
A high school physics teacher needs to digitize a handwritten draft of a 'Work and Energy' unit test. You must create a professional-looking exam paper in Apache OpenOffice Writer. 

1. Open Apache OpenOffice Writer.
2. Set Page Margins to 0.75 inches on all sides.
3. Create a Header with 'Westview Academy' (Centered, Bold, 14pt) and 'Physics 301 - Unit 3: Work and Energy' (Centered, 12pt).
4. Create a student details area (Name, Date, Period).
5. Copy the 4 questions from /home/ga/Documents/exam_draft.txt.
6. CRITICAL: Whenever the draft shows a math formula code (e.g., 'Formula: ...'), you MUST use 'Insert > Object > Formula' to create a proper mathematical object using the provided syntax. Do NOT just type the code as text.
7. Insert the image /home/ga/Documents/roller_coaster.png under Question 3.
8. Save the document as /home/ga/Documents/Physics_Unit3_Exam.odt.
